fast.change: Added a directory existence check for the .brain/cache path.
fast.impact: Introduced an optional diagnostic warning in the doctor report.

detailed.change: Inserted a logic block that verifies the presence of the .brain/cache directory within the project root. This check is appended to the diagnostics results list immediately following the initial project initialization check.
detailed.impact: The function now provides proactive feedback regarding missing cache directories, which helps users troubleshoot performance or storage issues. It does not affect the existing final_status calculation logic, ensuring backward compatibility with external dependencies.
detailed.risk: The modification is read-only and uses standard Pathlib methods, posing no danger to existing data or logic state. Severity: low
